reason: The wheels look fine but tyres aren't included unless the listing says so, and a set of four decent tyres would cost me far more than the wheels. On my money I can't take on that extra bill for looks.
objection: Are the tyres any good? If they aren't included I'm looking at another few hundred quid on top, and a new seller with no reviews doesn't help.
would_change_my_mind: A set that comes with tyres that have good stated tread depth (say 5mm+) for around the same money, for a fitment that matches my car.
